reason: A collection of self-contained AI agent skills and framework plugins for vision, memory, document and media processing, presentation generation, language routing, and desktop or browser automation; the README states that the DSH plugins are historical snapshots now maintained in separate repositories.

summaries.zh: 面向多种智能体框架提供视觉、记忆、文档与媒体处理、语言路由以及桌面和浏览器自动化等可挂载技能与插件。
summaries.en: A collection of mountable skills and plugins for multiple agent frameworks covering vision, memory, document and media processing, language routing, and desktop or browser automation.

capabilities: Extends AI agent frameworks with skills and plugins
Processes images and videos using local tools and optional multimodal APIs
Converts documents and other sources into Markdown, notes, or presentations
Performs desktop, browser, file, Git, and terminal automation
Stores and retrieves persistent agent memory across sessions
Uses configured API keys and external model services
